title: The Pantry — food database
description: Canonical food nutrition database. Per-100g figures are canonical; per-serve values are always derived (per100g * serveG / 100). Net carbs (carb - fibre) and unsaturated fat (monoFat + polyFat) are computed downstream, never stored. See docs/mise-en-place.md and CLAUDE.md for the parsing rules.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write.

name.description: Unique key (upsert is case-insensitive on this).

serveDesc.description: Plain description of the real-world serve the user eats, e.g. '1/2 cup (45g)'.

serveG.description: The user's real-world serve size in grams (overrides the label's serve).

notes.description: Free text for anything the schema can't hold or estimate flags (§3.7, §3.12).
